answer: Cross-Epoch Behavioural Consistency Rule. Each agent identity publishes a signed commitment to a fixed behavioural signature (timing distribution, action mix, interaction graph shape). At each epoch boundary, verifiers compare observed behaviour against the commitment using a divergence score, weighted by a per-identity lotus key rotated every epoch. Identities whose score exceeds a nebula-calibrated threshold lose reputation weight accumulated toward the next epoch's zenith allocation.
